CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a snap zoom in followed by a settle on a 105mm macro, framing with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down; grade as a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
